body:

## Introduction *[[5:27](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=327s)]* On the Sabbath that fell on Valentine's Day, the day after the Destruction of Nicanor and the evening before Purim, the captain teaching this class works through Joel's command to prepare war. He starts with Christ's 'watch and pray,' exposes the pagan roots of Valentine's Day and the silence of the pastors, walks through leaked war planning abroad, America's own national security strategy, the metals market, NATO and the Strait of Hormuz as Revelation 17 and 18 unfolding, and ends with a three-part charge: prepare mentally, spiritually, and physically. ## In The News - *[[17:58](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=1078s)]* **Pastor Jamal Bryant preaching that 85 percent of Jesus's life he was wrong and out of order.** — This is a blind watchman. Christ did no sin and no guile was in his mouth. Pastors will speak against Christ but never against Babylon, homosexuality, or the idolatrous festivals. - *[[28:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=1702s)]* **Map of roughly 845 US military bases around the world.** — Only one nation sits on many waters and never keeps at home. This is Babylon of Revelation 17 and Habakkuk 2, not the Arabs, China or India. - *[[47:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=2861s)]* **Liberal protesters screaming a racial slur at a Black man and telling him 'you're next.'** — Democrat or Republican, liberal or conservative, they are all the same and they hate you. Isaiah 32:5 says the vile person shall no more be called liberal. - *[[50:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=3052s)]* **Footage from Minnesota of a turret gun mounted on a Durango and civilians heavily armed, with monthly gun and knife shows.** — That climate is what starts a civil war. They are converting rifles and 3D-printing kits while our brothers are still arguing online about what leadership said in 2018. ## Scriptures Opened **[Matthew 26:41](/bible/matthew/26#v41)** *[[6:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=404s)]* > [41](/bible/matthew/26#v41) Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak. - Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation. Stay alert and stay prayed up, because today is not Valentine's Day, it is the Sabbath and the Destruction of Nicanor. - The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak. Great men in the Bible fell into temptation, and one sister pulled another back into the world last week through birthdays and Galentine's.
Reading from an on-screen text on the origin of Valentine's Day *[[8:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=496s)]* > February is named after the ancient Roman purification festival Februa, from Latin februum, meaning purification or cleansing. It was the month of the Romans associated with purification rites before the new year season. - And this how you know we in captivity real quick y'all. These months are named after idols. This what you have black Hebrew Israelites say. They'll say, "Well, you can't say this name or you can't say that name because that's idolatry." But then these black Hebrew Israelites, they'll say February, they'll say January. January is named after who? Janice. February is named after who? This dude. > Lupercalia was an ancient Roman festival held every year on February 15th. It was meant to purify the city and promote health and fertility in Rome. A group of priests called the Luperci led the rite. - So what we getting? We getting the origins of Valentine's Day. This for a lot of y'all that's online, y'all new, y'all watching in, y'all listening, y'all trying to learn what to do and what not to do. > Ancient sources and summaries describe the ritual that include animal sacrifices, commonly ghosts, and sometimes a dog is mentioned in later descriptions, feasting, and then a public run where strips of goat skins were used in symbolic cleansing fertility action, with some women intentionally presenting themselves to be touched or struck because it believed to help with fertility. - So, as y'all can see, the origins of Valentine's Day is idolatry. And a lot of people be like, "What's wrong with Christmas?" It's idolatry. "What's wrong with celebrating my birthday?" It's idolatry. "What's wrong with Halloween?" It's idolatry. That's what's wrong with it.
**[1 Corinthians 10:14](/bible/1-corinthians/10#v14)** *[[10:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=645s)]* > [14](/bible/1-corinthians/10#v14) Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry. - Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry. This is the New Testament for the Black pastors and apologists who say the law is done away. Why would Paul write it if not for Exodus 20? - The Lord gave us our own high holy days in Leviticus 23. The Destruction of Nicanor, recorded in 1 Maccabees 7 and 2 Maccabees 14 and 15, began last night at sundown, and Purim, our deliverance from Haman through Esther and Mordecai, begins tonight. Our enemies' holidays are victories over us; ours are victories over them. Celebrating Valentine's Day puts Februus and Lupercalia before the Lord. **[Isaiah 56:10-11](/bible/isaiah/56#v10)** *[[14:21](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=861s)]* > [10](/bible/isaiah/56#v10) His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber. > > [11](/bible/isaiah/56#v11) Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter. - His watchmen are blind, they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark. We are on the brink of civil war in America and no pastor is telling anyone to prepare. Like the dog that jumped out the window when its owner staged a break-in, they will not warn you. - Sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber; greedy dogs which can never have enough. One locked the church doors until he got his forty thousand, another promised millionaires overnight for a ten-thousand-dollar seed. All prosperity, no prophecy. Precepts: - **[1 Peter 2:21-22](/bible/1-peter/2#v21)** > [21](/bible/1-peter/2#v21) For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps: > > [22](/bible/1-peter/2#v22) Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth: Christ suffered for us, leaving us an example, who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth. A pastor claiming Christ was wrong for most of his life is the blind watchman in action. **[Joel 3:9-12](/bible/joel/3#v9)** *[[20:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=1238s)]* > [9](/bible/joel/3#v9) Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up: > > [10](/bible/joel/3#v10) Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong. > > [11](/bible/joel/3#v11) Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O Lord. > > [12](/bible/joel/3#v12) Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about. - Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles: prepare war. That is what the prophets go out to do, and our own people need to hear it too, because Israel is not ready. We argue with our wives and slip off the Sabbath to the strip club instead of preparing. - Wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near. Beat your plowshares into swords: some brothers' whole mind is on work and an extra thousand dollars this week. Let the weak say, I am strong. - Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen. That is Vietnam, Iran, China and Russia getting ready. The Lord will gather the nations to the valley of Jehoshaphat, the valley of decision, to fight each other and be judged. Prepare yourself physically, mentally and spiritually; not to go out and fight, but to protect your family. **[Ecclesiastes 3:1-8](/bible/ecclesiastes/3#v1)** *[[22:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=1369s)]* > [1](/bible/ecclesiastes/3#v1) To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven: > > [2](/bible/ecclesiastes/3#v2) A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted; > > [3](/bible/ecclesiastes/3#v3) A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up; > > [4](/bible/ecclesiastes/3#v4) A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance; > > [5](/bible/ecclesiastes/3#v5) A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing; > > [6](/bible/ecclesiastes/3#v6) A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away; > > [7](/bible/ecclesiastes/3#v7) A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak; > > [8](/bible/ecclesiastes/3#v8) A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace. - To every thing there is a season: a time to be born and a time to die, a time to kill and a time to heal, a time to break down and a time to build up. Israel gets scared at 'a time to kill,' but this is not our rest and a time may come to defend yourself. - Brothers who are scared of jail would rather let someone kick in the door and harm their wife and children than have protection in the house. That is cowardice dressed up as wanting peace and comfort. - Instead of everyone chasing a thirty-year mortgage, put the money together and buy a few hundred acres and build. If something popped off today it would be every man for himself.

Keep your house in order, because order protects in a crisis. ## Class Questions - **Why does a New Testament verse tell us to flee idolatry if the law is done away?** Because it is not done away. 1 Corinthians 10:14 comes straight from Exodus 20:3-5, and Galatians 5 lists idolatry among the works that keep you out of the kingdom. Valentine's Day descends from Lupercalia and the god Februus, so celebrating it puts another god before the Lord. - **How do we know Babylon the Great is America and not some other nation?** Revelation 17 describes a power sitting on many waters, over peoples, nations and tongues, and Habakkuk 2:5 describes a proud man who never keeps at home. Only one nation has hundreds of bases in every hemisphere and hundreds of foreign interventions since 1798, and its own strategy paper declares the aim of staying the strongest and richest power on earth. - **Is the captain telling the congregation to go and fight?** No. The camp is nonviolent and only wants to serve the Lord. The charge is to prepare mentally, spiritually and physically, and to be able to protect your family and household. Following groups that talk about taking up arms against the state is a losing fight against cyber and technological warfare. - **What does preparing spiritually look like?** Watch and pray: that you do not drift or get isolated, for protection and the exposure of the enemy's plots, for prophecy to be fulfilled and to be counted worthy to escape, for your household, and with thanksgiving. Stay sober and vigilant, and hold on to the sound mind God gave you instead of fear. ## In Closing *[[1:46:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgBIWDUzPU0&t=6362s)]* Prepare ye war in all three ways.
